injuries.detail: day-to-day
Sennecke (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.
Poehling (knee) is on the Ducks' current road trip and has resumed skating, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Thursday.
Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
Hagens (back) is wearing a non-contact sweater ahead of Tuesday's practice, Steve Conroy of the Boston Herald reports.
Kozak (undisclosed) did not practice Tuesday and is considered day-to-day, per Paul Hamilton of WGR Sports Radio 550.
ir
Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.
Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

Frost sustained an upper-body injury during Monday's 2-1 loss to the Senators, and head coach Ryan Huska did not have an update on the center's status after the game, Flames TV host Brendan Parker reports.
Pospisil (upper body) didn't travel with his teammates for the start of Calgary's five-game road trip, per Eric Francis of Sportsnet on Monday.
Huberdeau (hip) had three assists in AHL Calgary's 4-3 win over Coachella Valley on Wednesday.
Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.
out
Bedard underwent successful shoulder surgery Monday and is expected to make a full recovery in approximately four months, the Blackhawks announced.
day-to-day
Kaiser was suspended for three games by the NHL Department of Player Safety on Sunday for an illegal check to the head against Calgary's Martin Pospisil (upper body) on Saturday.
Byram (upper body) didn't accompany his teammates on Chicago's three-game road trip, per Mark Lazerus of The Athletic on Saturday.
Makar (lower body) was on the ice in a regular sweater ahead of Wednesday's clash with Montreal, Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette reports.
out
MacKinnon (lower body) has been evaluated by a specialist and is expected to miss the next 12 weeks, Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now reports Saturday.
ir
ir-lt
ir
day-to-day
Myers (upper body) has a chance to return in Wednesday's home clash against the Predators, per Robert Tiffin of NHL.com.
Back (finger) is expected to return within the next week, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports Thursday.
